definitions.explanation: The last day of the year.

examples.japanese: {大晦日|おおみそか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧。
{大晦日|おおみそか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{紅白|こうはく}→紅白：13805_kouhaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, we watch Kohaku.

examples.japanese: {大晦日|おおみそか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{年越|としこ}し→年越し：12477_toshikoshi⟧⟦そば→蕎麦：14329_soba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: To eat year-crossing soba on New Year's Eve.

examples.japanese: {大晦日|おおみそか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。

examples.english: On New Year's Eve, you can hear the temple bells ringing, and you feel the new year beginning.
examples.notes: Temple bells are rung 108 times at midnight

notes:
{大晦日|おおみそか} is December 31st — the last day of the year. It is one of the most culturally significant days in Japan.

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{晦日|みそか}→三十日：16272_misoka⟧ means the last day of the month. {大晦日|おおみそか} is the 'great' last day — the last day of the year.

NEW YEAR'S EVE CUSTOMS:
- ⟦{年越|としこ}し→年越し：12477_toshikoshi⟧⟦そば→蕎麦：14329_soba⟧: eating soba noodles for longevity
- ⟦{紅白歌合戦|こうはくうたがっせん}→紅白歌合戦：29111_kouhakuutagassen⟧: NHK's annual music show (Kohaku)
- ⟦{除夜|じょや}→除夜：14590_joya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鐘|かね}→鐘：02654_kane⟧: temple bells rung 108 times at midnight
- ⟦{大掃除|おおそうじ}→大掃除：08347_oosouji⟧: year-end deep cleaning (done before {大晦日|おおみそか})
